name: CI/CD pipeline
short_description: A CI/CD pipeline is an automated, fixed sequence of steps (trigger, build, test, artifact, deploy) that runs the same way every time software changes, combining continuous integration with continuous delivery or deployment.

evidence.quote: A CI CD pipeline is a factory line for software
